newsitem.title: MALAWI: Zambia's Kaunda lobbying for support in Malawi.
newsitem.headline: Zambia's Kaunda lobbying for support in Malawi.

text.p: Former Zambian President Kenneth Kaunda, who was prevented from participating in his country's presidential polls last year, on Wednesday visited Malawi President Bakili Muluzi to lobby for support.

State radio said Kaunda told reporters in the Malawi capital Lilongwe his visit was part of a tour of some of the 12 Southern Africa Development Community (SADC) countries to brief them about his country's political status.

Kaunda, who leads Zambia's main opposition United National Independence Party (UNIP), was barred from contesting the elections November last year because his parents were not from Zambia but from Malawi.
